yes.0: Why? Those #o6130207#s steal so many peaches that the Peach Farm is currently devoid of peaches. How sad is that? I even go on night watch every so often to protect the farm, but those monkeys are so fast, and there are so many of them around, that there's no way I can prevent them from invading.

no.0: If you don't want to do it, then... oh well, maybe I should ask #p2091000#...

yes.0: The peaches from this farm are renowned for their great taste. Not only that, they are proven to increase brain activity, as well as assisting one to quickly master new skills. They are also used as an ingredient for medicines. All that, and the #o6130207#s kept stealing them...sigh... Well, at least now that the number of #o6130207#s has decreased greatly, I may be able to grow some more peaches and make money again.
